command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj field.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (LF, trailing newline): a comment block then `b #0` / `b #4` / `b #-4`. The three words are `00 00 00 14`, `01 00 00 14` and `ff ff ff 17`: bit 31 is 0 for `b` (it is 1 for `bl`), bits 29-26 are `1001`, and imm26 sits at 0-25. llvm-mc's `#n` is a byte displacement, so the plan's field values 0, 1 and -1 are spelled `#0`, `#4` and `#-4` in the source. No relocations: the values are literals.
source: Arm MRS `B` (op = 0 at 31, 00 at 29-30, 101 at 26-28, imm26 at 0-25), measured in EXP-0101 §1
